resources.string: Enter your Tencent Cloud AppID, SecretId and SecretKey in speech recognition settings first.
This model was not saved. Only 16k_ engine models are supported; the last valid model remains active.

Default: 16k_zh (Mandarin). Examples: 16k_en (English), 16k_yue (Cantonese), 16k_zh-TW (Traditional Chinese). Only 16k_ models are supported because audio is recorded at 16 kHz. Leave blank to use the default.

Enable Tencent Cloud ASR and enter your own AppID, SecretId and SecretKey. No Tencent credentials are embedded in this app. Audio is sent to Tencent Cloud during recognition, and realtime ASR usage is billed to your Tencent Cloud account under its current pricing. Credentials are stored locally and included in exported settings backups; keep those files private.
